Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tanetsuchi-akihuyu/

Join a tour to build mushroom-style garden rows (kinichan hatake) using fallen leaves and branches, sow autumn vegetable seeds, plant seedlings, and help maintain the garden. A kinichan farming method adviser will explain daily care tips in easy-to-understand steps. Lunch features an Italian meal made with kinichan vegetables, served at a restaurant.

【Participation Fee】Adults ¥8,800 / Junior high school and under ¥2,200 (includes guide, lunch, materials, and insurance)

【Capacity】15 people

【Guide】Hanno Tane to Tsuchi Farm staff

【What to bring】Drinking water, hat, towel, gloves, and other suitable gear
location: 集合 ラ・ノーラ前の畑 （飯能市下加治243-25、イーグルバス「飯能靖和病院」下車徒歩8分）
